label: OTTO Market
terms_note: OTTO Market seller contract (Germany, GmbH/registered business, German-language customer service); API app credentials from the partner portal; sandbox access granted by OTTO; service-partner model with seller consent delegation; rate limits exist (numbers not read).

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (app credentials from the OTTO Market / Partner Connect portal; service partners act with seller consent)

rate_limits: 1,200 requests/min per partner, 20 rps per partner-id, lower per endpoint; 429

auth: 1. Seller (or the platform as Service Partner) obtains app credentials in the OTTO Market partner portal; sandbox access requested there.
2. POST client_credentials → bearer token; refresh on expiry.
3. Service partners operate seller accounts only with the seller's consent delegation.

endpoints.purpose: create / update products + variations (SKU, EAN, media, delivery)

reference.limits: Implemented; thresholds in the full documentation (not read). - Seller contract with OTTO Market; service-partner consent model. - Germany only.
mcp_sdk: SDK: OpenAPI specifications per interface (API Index)

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of a self-app created in OTTO Partner Connect > API access with the Products, Availability, Orders and Shipments interfaces enabled (https://api.otto.market/docs/sellers-integration).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's client secret (shown once in Partner Connect). Tokens are minted with the client credentials and the scopes 'products availability orders shipments'.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Price currency for update_listing, EUR for otto.de.

adapter.terms: OTTO Market API (Germany). Product price and active-status updates are asynchronous (202 with a process to poll under /v5/products/update-tasks/{processUuid}).

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe mints a token and reads one SKU quantity ({resources: {variations[]}}) to verify the credentials and scopes.

update_listing.note: Products-V5 updateProductVariationPrices POST /v5/products/prices [{sku, standardPrice: {amount, currency}}] sets the LIVE standard price of your SKU (listing_id = SKU; currency from the config field, EUR). Only the price is applied (`price` required); stock is set_inventory and product content goes through POST /v5/products. Asynchronous: status pending|done, raw.links point at the process.

set_inventory.note: Availability-V1 POST /v1/availability/quantities [{sku, quantity}] sets the available quantity of one SKU (`sku` required; any integer >= 0). Answers 207 with per-SKU results/errors in raw.

end_listing.note: Products-V5 updateActiveStatus {status: [{sku, active: false}]} takes the SKU offline on otto.de (reversible with active: true). Asynchronous process (state pending|done).

list_orders.note: Orders-V4 GET /v4/orders?fulfillmentStatus(ANNOUNCED|PROCESSABLE|SENT|RETURNED|CANCELLED_BY_PARTNER|CANCELLED_BY_MARKETPLACE)&fromOrderDate(ISO-8601)&limit(max 256), oldest first. Status is per position item (the first item's is shown); raw.salesOrderId and positionItems[].positionItemId are needed for shipping and cancellations. Paging is by cursor (raw.links next), so only the first page is returned.

not_offered.create_listing: POST /v5/products takes full product variations (productReference, category, brand, attributes, media, delivery, pricing) and requires a shipping profile assignment before the SKU becomes orderable; the vocabulary lacks category, brand and attributes.
not_offered.mark_shipped: POST /v1/shipments requires shipDate, shipFromAddress and, per position item, positionItemId + salesOrderId + a RETURN tracking key; position items and return labels are not vocabulary inputs.

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
